Subject: SLA options & pricing for Greenfield AI pilot

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We are preparing an internal ask for a 6-month pilot and need a clear SLA catalog + pricing bands for uptime, response times, and escalation coverage.

High-level requirements:
- Pilot expected: 100M tokens/month, spikes to 2M tokens/day
- Critical traffic: inference for customer-facing assistants (SLO target: 99.9+)
- Need 24/7 escalation contact for Sev1 incidents and a named technical lead
- Billing preference: monthly invoice; open to a retainer model if it lowers unit cost

Can you send (1) a short catalog of recommended SLA tiers, (2) an example pricing quote with retainer and volume discounts, and (3) any prerequisites (onboarding timeline, support hours, legal/PO info)?

I've attached our SLO worksheet — please ignore internal notes.

Thanks,
Maria
Maria Lopez
Head of Infra, Greenfield AI

Subject: Re: SLA options & pricing for Greenfield AI pilot

Hi Maria — great to connect. Appreciate the worksheet, that helped a lot. High-level response below; I added Karthik (pricing) and Vanessa (ops/onsite cadence) to make sure we cover handoffs.

Summary (short catalog):
- Standard: 99.5% uptime, business-hours support (M-F 9–6 local), Sev1 response 4 hrs, no guaranteed on-call SLA.
- Assured: 99.9% uptime, 24/7 triage, Sev1 initial response 60 mins, Named Technical Lead (NTL) during incidents, monthly runbook review.
- Enterprise: 99.99% uptime, 24/7 NTL + escalation path, Sev1 initial response 15 mins, annual tabletop + priority on capacity bursts and regional failover support.

Pricing sketch (pilot / 6 months):
- Retainer model reduces unit cost — example tiers for 100M tokens/month baseline:
  - Standard: $0.0008 / token; no retainer; invoice monthly.
  - Assured: $0.00065 / token + $7,500/mo retainer (covers NTL + 24/7 triage).
  - Enterprise: $0.00045 / token + $25,000/mo retainer (includes guaranteed on-call coverage, runbook ops time).

Concessions we can do for a pilot: 10% off list rates for a 6-month committed pilot, or 18% off for a 12-month commit. We can also amortize onboarding fees over the first two months of the pilot.

Prereqs / timeline:
- Legal/PO: standard MSA + SOW; typical procurement 2–4 weeks.
- Onboarding: 2–3 weeks for production integrations, 1-week ramp.
- Named contacts: need a Greenfield escalation roster and IP allowlist for private endpoints if using VPC.

Next steps I propose:
1) If Assured or Enterprise looks right, share a short confirmation of traffic shape (peak qps and latency sensitivity).
2) We will convert the sketch above into a one-page quote + SOW and share a DocuSign link.

I've attached a concise pricing sketch and a quick workback we use internally.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-03T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: pricing flexibility for Greenfield pilot

Neha / Vanessa — quick internal note while we draft the quote:

- Given Greenfield's use case (customer-facing assistants + spikes), I recommend pushing for Assured as the baseline. It balances cost vs. risk for them and reduces our on-call overhead compared to Enterprise.
- Concession idea: for a 6-month pilot at the 100M baseline, approve an additional 12% off Assured if Greenfield signs a 12-month auto-renew clause at a pre-agreed uplift. This is easier than moving to Enterprise pricing for the pilot.
- Waive the first-month retainer (or charge 50%) if they accept a 30-day accelerated PO and agree to a short tabletop in week 1.

If you want, I can draft the numeric example with the blended unit cost and monthly invoice schedule.

Karthik
Director, Commercial Pricing
